description: Lusca helps Shopify merchants connect their store and marketing accounts to ChatGPT. It reviews catalog health, Google Ads performance, Merchant Center feed status, and Search Console demand signals, then prepares safe recommendations and daily reports. Any action that could change a store or campaign is shown in an approval screen and requires explicit human approval before execution.

defaultPrompt: Connect Lusca to my ChatGPT account.
Run a read-only store audit and show top findings.
Prepare a PMax budget review before applying it.
